mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.type, c.title, c.body, c.mediaUrl, c.workCategoryId, wc.name AS workCategoryName, DATE_FORMAT(c.createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM content c LEFT JOIN workcategory wc ON c.workCategoryId = wc.id WHERE c.isPublished = 1 ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.title, c.body, c.mediaUrl, c.workCategoryId, wc.name AS workCategoryName, DATE_FORMAT(c.createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM content c LEFT JOIN workcategory wc ON c.workCategoryId = wc.id WHERE c.type = #{type} AND c.isPublished = 1 ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.title, c.body, c.mediaUrl, c.isPublished, c.workCategoryId, wc.name AS workCategoryName, DATE_FORMAT(c.createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM content c LEFT JOIN workcategory wc ON c.workCategoryId = wc.id ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.title, c.body, c.mediaUrl, c.isPublished, c.workCategoryId, wc.name AS workCategoryName, DATE_FORMAT(c.createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM content c LEFT JOIN workcategory wc ON c.workCategoryId = wc.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE content SET isPublished=#{isPublished}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content (id, type, title, body, mediaUrl, isPublished, workCategoryId, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{mediaUrl}, #{isPublished}, #{workCategoryId}, NOW(), NOW())
